market_name: Will 2 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the prediction-market probability shift persists or reverses; cross-check fed funds futures (CME FedWatch) and 2y yield for corroboration.
time_plan.1h: Confirm TLT direction against 10y yield move; verify no offsetting hawkish Fed headline or hot data print.
time_plan.2h: Assess whether move is idiosyncratic to the prediction market or reflected broadly in rates; watch for mean reversion.
time_plan.6h: Re-evaluate against any intraday Fed speaker commentary or Treasury auction results.
time_plan.12h: Mark final TLT return vs baseline; log whether the prediction-market signal led or lagged the rates move.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of 2 Fed rate cuts in 2026 signals a more dovish rate path than currently priced. Lower expected policy rates pull down the belly and long end of the Treasury curve, lifting bond prices. TLT is a highly liquid, high-duration proxy that responds directly to shifts in Fed expectations. The link is mechanical but the 12h magnitude is modest because a single prediction-market repricing rarely dominates Treasury flows dominated by macro data and Fed speak.

predictions.tradable_instrument_name: Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check DXY and EURUSD for confirmation alongside the rate move; verify the prediction-market shift is dovish (higher cut probability).
time_plan.1h: Confirm dollar weakness is broad-based, not a single-cross artifact.
time_plan.2h: Watch for risk-off flows that could reverse the dollar into safe-haven bid.
time_plan.6h: Reassess against ECB/BoJ headlines and any US data surprises.
time_plan.12h: Mark final UUP return and note whether FX confirmed or contradicted the rates signal.

predictions.reasoning: More expected Fed cuts narrow US rate differentials versus other G10 currencies, which is typically dollar-negative. UUP is a liquid DXY proxy. The mapping is directionally sound but weaker than the Treasury link because FX also depends on relative central-bank paths abroad, and a domestic dovish repricing can be offset if global growth fears simultaneously drive safe-haven dollar demand.

evidence_used: Market question directly tracks the number of 2026 Fed 25bp cuts, a pure monetary-policy signal
Standard transmission: more expected cuts -> lower yields -> higher bond prices, weaker dollar, generally supportive of equities
TLT and UUP are highly liquid, direct proxies for rate-path expectations
uncertainty_notes: The market question gives no direction of the anomaly; predictions assume a dovish repricing (rising probability of 2 cuts). A hawkish shift flips all signs.
Fed-path repricing is largely already reflected in fed funds futures, so a prediction-market move may be redundant/already public.
12h magnitudes are far below the 700bps tradable threshold; these are research signals, not tradable.
Category tag 'military_conflict' appears mislabeled; treated as a monetary-policy market.

llm_justification.summary: This market is a direct barometer of the expected 2026 Fed easing path. A sharp increase in the implied probability of 2 cuts implies a more dovish path than priced, which mechanically supports long-duration Treasuries (TLT up) and pressures the dollar (UUP down). Both links are directionally standard but modest over 12h, and neither reaches the 700bps tradable threshold, so this is a low-conviction research mapping. Direction hinges entirely on the sign of the probability move, which is not specified.
key_assumptions: The observed anomaly is a rise (not fall) in the probability of exactly/at-least 2 cuts, i.e. dovish
The prediction-market shift carries incremental information beyond existing fed funds futures
No dominant offsetting macro shock (hot inflation, risk-off) hits within the window
failure_modes: The prediction-market move reverses as noise or thin liquidity, taking TLT/UUP moves with it
The Fed-path repricing is already fully public in futures, so no asset reaction follows
Dollar link fails if a global risk-off event drives safe-haven dollar demand despite dovish Fed pricing
Direction assumption is wrong — a hawkish repricing would invert both predictions
Weak proxy exposure: 12h moves swamped by unrelated Treasury/FX flows and scheduled data
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
